name: Baral and Kari Zev
oracle_text:
First strike, menace
Whenever you cast your first instant or sorcery spell each turn, you may cast a spell with lesser mana value that shares a card type with it from your hand without paying its mana cost. If you don't, create First Mate Ragavan, a legendary 2/1 red Monkey Pirate creature token. It gains haste until end of turn.

needs.what: First Mate Ragavan, a legendary 2/1 red Monkey Pirate creature token (named token, supertype Legendary, no abilities)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has no Ragavan or legendary 2/1 red Monkey Pirate; the only Pirate is pirate_2_2_b_menace, which is a different token

needs.what: cast_from_hand needs an `as` binding (or equivalent) recording whether a spell was actually cast, so a following `if` can run the 'If you don't' branch only when the player declined or had nothing to cast
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cast_from_hand's option list is exiles/objects/per_owner/player/selector/zones with no `as`; its optionality is internal (ask_objects with minimum 0), so wrapping it in `may` with an `else` would let the player say yes and then pick nothing, skipping both the cast and the token
